_readme: RETIRED 2026-08-20 by operator ruling (Aaron): 'You can remove these for all characters, we don't need them ever again.'
Every per-part limit (blockAllMotion, angle windows, duration caps, noRetractBelowMin, powerGroup serialization,
excludeFromAutomatedTests) was removed for every character. Do not re-add entries without his direction.
The enforcement code (services/hardwareService/safetyLimits.js) still reads this file and applies nothing when empty;
its removal is the deferred safety-teardown job in V11-HANDOFF/V11-DECISIONS.
EXCEPTION by operator direction 2026-10-18: Groundbreaker's turn motor (char 5 part 1) below. Leave it in place.

1.notes: Operator 2026-10-18: 12V wiper motor (BTS7960) turning Groundbreaker; he was centered facing forward. 'Dont turn him more than 1500ms at 50% in either direction.' Clamped in python_wrappers/mb_safety.py on every drive, calibration Home included. One drive is capped, not his position: two drives the same way still add up, so the open-loop tracker (center p=0.5, full span 3000 ms at 50%) is what keeps him inside the window. There is no endstop - never Home this part.
